question: Who built an elegant two-storey 'ship palace' between two reservoirs named Jahaz Mahal?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sultan Ghiyasuddin Khilji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jahaz Mahal**, also known as the "Ship Palace," is a remarkable architectural structure located in **Mandu, Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It was constructed during the reign of **Sultan Ghiyasuddin Khilji**, one of the rulers of the **Malwa Sultanate.**
 
• The palace was built between two artificial reservoirs, namely the **Kapur Talao** and **Munja Talao**, creating the illusion of a ship floating on water.
 
• **Sultan Ghiyasuddin Khilji** was known for his love of art, architecture, and luxurious lifestyle, which is reflected in the design of Jahaz Mahal.
 
• The primary purpose of the palace was to accommodate the royal harem, which included thousands of women, and provide a serene and picturesque environment for leisure and entertainment.
 
• The architectural style of Jahaz Mahal showcases the blending of **Islamic** and **local Indian designs,** demonstrating the cultural synthesis of the period.
 
• The palace features intricate carvings, expansive halls, and terraces, along with water channels that enhanced its aesthetic appeal.
 
• Jahaz Mahal is a popular tourist destination and an important historical site that reflects the grandeur of the **Malwa Sultanate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sultan Muhammad Bin Tughlaq**__

 __
 
• **Sultan Muhammad Bin Tughlaq** was the ruler of the **Tughlaq dynasty** in Delhi and is known for his ambitious but often impractical projects.
 
• He shifted the capital from Delhi to **Daulatabad** and introduced token currency, both of which failed significantly.
 
• He was not associated with the construction of Jahaz Mahal as his reign focused on other administrative and military reforms.
 
 
 
• **Sultan Alauddin Khilji**__
 __
 
• **Sultan Alauddin Khilji** was a prominent ruler of the **Khilji dynasty**, known for his military conquests and economic reforms.
 
• He introduced the ** to control prices and ensure the welfare of his subjects.
 
• While he was a visionary ruler, he was not connected to the construction of Jahaz Mahal.
 
 
 
• Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq**__
 
 
• **Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq** was the founder of the **Tughlaq dynasty** and is renowned for building the fortified city of **Tughlaqabad** in Delhi.
 
• His architectural achievements were focused in Delhi and not in Mandu; hence, he is not associated with Jahaz Mahal.
